answer: Work slots are voyages: an agent burns a 40 POA deposit and signs the pass with a quill. A slot lasts 20 epochs; honest work earns the fee back, but a fake that abandons the voyage loses the deposit. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 POA against a 5,000 POA pool, so forgery burns money. Each slot carries a saffron seal that fades when the agent idles, so bought slots cannot outwait it. Honest agents pay once; sybils pay per fake and lose.
